# UIFlexItem

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIFlexItem")`

Says how its parent behaves as a child of a `UIListLayout` (ADR 0128): whether it grows into room that is left over, whether it shrinks when the line is too long, and where it sits across the line. Parented to the child it is about, not beside it.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FlexMode` | `Enum.UIFlexMode` | `Enum.UIFlexMode.None` | read/write | Whether it grows, shrinks, or both. |
| `GrowRatio` | `number` | `1` | read/write | Its share of the room left over, against the other children that grow, when `FlexMode` is `Custom`: one at 2 beside one at 1 takes two thirds. |
| `ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Automatic` | read/write | Where it sits across its line; `Automatic` is as the layout says. |
| `ShrinkRatio` | `number` | `1` | read/write | Its share of what the line is short by, against the others that shrink, when `FlexMode` is `Custom`. |
